protocol: One bounded iteration continuation of the training-selected larger SG fit
selection_evidence: The best of three 2400-iteration fits is selected by training loss. Its loss decreases from 0.0008534 at iteration2000 to 0.0007786 at2400. This continuation tests the unresolved iteration limit.
initialization: Start from the recorded best vector of the preceding N96,d48,columns32,L12,r10 fit. SLSQP curvature state restarts. This is a continuation, not an independent restart.
objective: The same common-phase action MSE formula, uniformly weighted on the first 32 columns, with regularization 1e-8 and unchanged phase/displacement bounds.
selection: Minimum training objective among all three starts, selected before full-circuit evaluation.
acceptance: Original SG thresholds and 96/128 validation. A boundary-only limitation can receive one same-parameter 128/160 refinement.
stopping_rule: Stop after this single continuation and the unchanged full-circuit validation. No new size or initialization search follows in this refinement.
independent_evaluation: The second physical preparation and fixed trig circuits remain those declared before the preceding initialization comparison. They are not used in this training or selection.
